name: goku
description: Browse PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB and MongoDB databases and their ER diagrams, like the Goku app.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Connections from workspace settings and .env files are only read in trusted workspaces.

goku.connections.markdownDescription: Connections, in the same shape as the Goku app's profiles (`name`, `kind`, `hosts`, `user`, `database`, `ssl`, `ssh`, `readOnly`, …). Never put passwords here: Goku asks for them and keeps them in VS Code's secret storage.

goku.envFiles.markdownDescription: Files, relative to each workspace folder, searched for `DATABASE_URL`, `POSTGRES_URL`, `MYSQL_URL`, `MONGODB_URI`, `PGHOST`/`PGDATABASE`, `MYSQL_HOST`/`MYSQL_DATABASE` and similar variables. Connections found there are read-only by default, read their password from the file when connecting, and are ignored in untrusted workspaces.

goku.envConnections.markdownDescription: More connection URLs in the env files, e.g. `{"url": "ANALYTICS_DB_URL", "name": "Analytics", "readOnly": false}`. `url` is the variable's name; `file` limits the entry to one of `goku.envFiles`; `kind` is for URLs whose scheme doesn't say. An entry for a well-known variable such as `DATABASE_URL` overrides its name and read-only default.

url.description: Name of the variable that holds the connection URL.

file.description: Only in this env file (as written in goku.envFiles).

goku.enginePath.markdownDescription: Path to a `goku-engine-server` to use instead of the bundled one (for engine development). Machine scope only, so a workspace can't point it at another program.
